subject: Civic Education
lesson: Accepts the view that the positively control of emotions as a democratic citizen bring about the betterment of the person as well as the society: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency 8.2.3
unique_learning_outcome: Accepts the view that the positively control of emotions as a democratic citizen bring about the betterment of the person as well as the society.
Describes giving examples the nature of various kinds of emotions occuring in a person.
the_entrance: Detailed 5-minute introduction: teacher and student actions linking prior knowledge to this period topic and activity... Students are introduced to the concept of emotions and their impact on personal behavior. The teacher explains the scenario and objectives of the mock local council/pradeshiya sabha session.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher circulates as facilitator among groups, observes peer interactions, scaffolds challenging concepts with probing questions, and ensures active participation without lecturing.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students actively execute the chosen activity (e.g., conducting mock council session, exploratory school-walk survey, analyzing Sri Lankan community issues, or solving civic challenges in groups) using assigned roles.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_method: Active Student-Centered Investigation / Simulation / Drama / School-Walk
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Worksheets, roleplay cue cards, chart papers, colored markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher moderates student presentations, facilitates constructive peer review, and synthesizes key student discoveries directly against the period's learning outcomes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Spokespersons present group solutions or roleplay outcomes; class peers ask questions, provide constructive feedback, and summarize key takeaways in their notebooks.

summary: Consolidation and synthesis of key concepts...
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Accepts the view that the positively control of emotions as a democratic citizen bring about the betterment of the person as well as the society” using evidence or an example from Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency 8.2.3. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
selected_activity:
Activity: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency 8.2.3
Approach: Students use mock local council / pradeshiya sabha session to explore 'Accepts the view that the positively control of emotions as a democratic citizen bring about the betterment of the person as well as the society.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
